profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Clarity
profile.summary: I am currently a principal software engineer at Clarity. I've performed both DevOps and Full Stack web development roles as well as Golang software micro service development, but would love to work on lower level projects like operating systems and firmware.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Leveraging Golang, containerization, and Kubernetes to orchestrate Cyber capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Leveraging Kubernetes and Golang to develop a scalable and intuitive interface for cyber security applications to work together.

positions.title: Intermediate Software Engineer/Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Created an internal React search application that indexed and searched across multiple
internal sites to enabled developers quick and easy access to documentation
- Developed a React schema site to give analysts one place to view schemas
- Designed a division wide landing site to showcase our division’s products and services
using Nextjs (NodeJS plus ReactJS)
- Provided consultation to the US government on DevOps best practices and microservice
architecture, and designed an automated testing suite for such services in Nightwatch
- Created a development platform for FAA project teams using AWS EKS in conjunction
with Concourse, Rancher, Grafana, and Prometheus for CI/CD to create a scalable,
multi-tenant platform that is now hosted in production for the enterprise
- Moved the platform into an Infrastructure as Code solution for portability with Terraform

positions.title: Silicon Validation Intern
positions.description:
- Utilized Docker, Ansible, and Python scripts to improve test suite scalability
- Used Python to design tests for silicon chips and their peripherals
- Debugged firmware written in C++ to capture video signals
- Collaborated with different Tesla teams to test autopilot and infotainment boards

honors.title: Spark Award
honors.description:
Thank you for elevating our project with all your contributions as a self-learner,
hard worker, and innovator. You demonstrated great leadership as task lead performing
way above expectations.

honors.title: Catalyst Award
honors.description:
Julian has gone above and beyond with his contributions to the CRE.
Applying his distinguished understanding of Kubernetes and AWS, he implemented
several core management and monitoring services (Prometheus, Rancher, and Grafana)
essential to the growth brought by new teams in the CRE. He has an essential role in
shaping our cloud work in the future.

projects.title: Portfolio Site
projects.description:
Developed a NextJS/ReactJS website that allowed me to practice coding WebGL with
ThreeJS, accessing databases with MongoDB, and working on the backend with NodeJS

projects.title: Unreal Engine 4 Simulation
projects.description:
Developed a simulation in Unreal Engine 4 for a local history museum. The
documentation for the project is hosted on GitHub actions at
https://julesverne22.github.io/Bombgineers-Docs/
